title: Error in the critical dimension approximation
statement: For a natural number $w$, define the critical dimension error to be $(\log 2)w2^w$ minus the critical dimension at width $w$.
caveat: The definition of critical dimension is not included in the supplied definitions, so its mathematical meaning cannot be specified more fully.
